input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the requirement to disclose and match third-party offers before engaging another provider: it operates as a de facto exclusivity/right of first refusal on us, and our playbook does not accept exclusivity or sole-supplier obligations on the customer. It also contradicts Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment. If Vendor needs something here, we could consider a narrow exclusivity limited to a defined service category, capped at twelve months and ending automatically if Vendor misses a service level or delivery date.
input.summary: Delete Section 7.2 disclose-and-match obligation (de facto exclusivity/ROFR on Customer).
